title: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, academic
question: For each academic year and department, what is the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only terms where the term status indicator is 'P' and the number of enrolled students is greater than 0), the department name, the total number of such library subjects offered per department in that year, and the highest average total units for subjects that department has ever offered in a regular academic term? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH library_base AS (
    SELECT
        at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
        at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
        lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
        lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
        lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
        lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
    JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
    WHERE at.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'
      AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
),
library_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ACADemic_YEAR,
        ACADemic_YEAR_DESC,
        OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
        OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
        VAR_SAMP(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_enrolled,
        COUNT(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects
    FROM library_base
    GROUP BY ACADemic_YEAR, ACADemic_YEAR_DESC, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE
),
subject_avg_units AS (
    SELECT
        ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        ccso.SUBJECT_ID,
        AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
    JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
    WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'
      AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_ID
),
department_max_avg_units AS (
    SELECT
        DEPARTMENT_CODE,
        MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units
    FROM subject_avg_units
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
SELECT
    ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    ls.variance_enrolled,
    ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    ls.total_library_subjects,
    dmu.highest_avg_total_units
FROM library_stats ls
LEFT JOIN department_max_avg_units dmu ON ls.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE
ORDER BY ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ls.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    lci.DEPARTMENT,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    lso.SUBJECT_ID,
    at.IS_REGULAR_TERM
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
  JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON at.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
  JOIN LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR lci ON lso.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
  WHERE at.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'
    AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    ACADemic_YEAR,
    ACADemic_YEAR_DESC,
    DEPARTMENT,
    VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_enrolled,
    COUNT(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_subjects
  FROM base
  GROUP BY ACADemic_YEAR, ACADemic_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT
),
max_avg_units AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT,
    MAX(avg_units) AS highest_avg_total_units
  FROM (
    SELECT
      b.DEPARTMENT,
      b.SUBJECT_ID,
      AVG(cc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units
    FROM base b
    JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG cc ON b.SUBJECT_ID = cc.SUBJECT_ID
    JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON b.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
    WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'
      AND cc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.DEPARTMENT, b.SUBJECT_ID
  ) sub
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT
)

  s.DEPARTMENT,

FROM stats s
LEFT JOIN max_avg_units m ON s.DEPARTMENT = m.DEPARTMENT

t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), subquery2 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), CombinedResults AS (SELECT 'Highest Variance Year' AS Result_Type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, NULL AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS material_count, NULL AS min_term_code FROM subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Textbook Materials' AS Result_Type, s2.academic_year, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS record_count_variance, NULL AS Most_Represented_Department, NULL AS Subject_Count, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.material_count, s2.min_term_code FROM subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Result_Type, academic_year, min_term_code

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, t1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, t2.IS_REGULAR_TERM FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.TERM_END_DATE, s1.window_column, s1.IS_CURRENT_TERM, s1.IS_REGULAR_TERM, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.benchmark_enrollment, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE), variance_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte1.enrolled_students_stddev, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_stats), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), admin_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, vs.enrolled_students_variance, vs.enrolled_students_stddev, vs.variance_category, ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ast.coefficient_of_variation, ast.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM variance_stats AS vs JOIN admin_stats AS ast ON vs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY vs.enrolled_students_variance DESC

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH academic_year_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_library_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), sponsor_type_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY) SELECT i.SPONSOR_TYPE, i.SPONSOR_NAME, i.max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE) AS t ON i.SPONSOR_TYPE = t.SPONSOR_TYPE) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.enrolled_students_variance, ayv.department_name, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered, stv.SPONSOR_TYPE, stv.SPONSOR_NAME, stv.max_enrollment_variance FROM academic_year_variance AS ayv CROSS JOIN sponsor_type_variance AS stv ORDER BY ayv.enrolled_students_variance DESC, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered DESC, stv.max_enrollment_variance DESC

sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

= 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / variability_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
